extraction.Name: Charles Lunderman
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 14, 1918 but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Lunderman and his wife conveyed the land to Adam J. Ichenefeld for $6500.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612820 issued; northwest quarter of section 34, township 95, range 71; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 11, 1918; conveyance dated February 13, 1918
